derivation: from H2790 (חָרַשׁ) in the sense of silence;
def: quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind)

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
